{{- /* Giscus — full upstream-equivalent loader */ -}} {{- $g := .Site.Params.giscus | default dict -}} {{- if not ($g.repo | default "") }}{{/* credentials required */}}{{ else }} {{- $c := .Site.Params.comments | default dict -}} {{- $themes := $g.theme | default dict -}} {{- $light := $themes.light | default "light" -}} {{- $dark := $themes.dark | default "dark" -}} {{- $option := $g.option | default dict -}} {{- $lazyload := $c.lazyload | default false -}} {{- $use := $c.use | default slice -}} {{- if reflect.IsSlice $use | not }}{{ if $use }}{{ $use = slice $use }}{{ else }}{{ $use = slice }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $norm := slice -}} {{- range $use }}{{ $norm = $norm | append (. | title) }}{{ end -}} {{- $first := "" }}{{ if gt (len $norm) 0 }}{{ $first = index $norm 0 }}{{ end -}} {{- $giscusUrl := $g.js | default "https://giscus.app/client.js" -}} {{- end }}
